children: USD.AI opens Season 2 airdrop claims on Arbitrum on October 20, 2026, at 15:00 (11 AM ET). The claim window runs through January 31, 2027. The allocation totals 225 million CHIP, representing 2.25% of supply, with no lockup or vesting. Any CHIP left unclaimed when the window closes is forfeited.

The absence of lockup or vesting means claimed tokens are liquid rather than subject to a scheduled release. The allocation represents supply that can become available as recipients claim it, not evidence that the full amount will enter circulation or be sold. Actual claim volumes and selling behavior during the window are not established.

title: USD.AI: Season 2 airdrop claims open on Arbitrum - 20 Oct 2026 to 31 Jan 2027
